items.en: Russia strikes Ukraine overnight 16–17 October with Iskander-M/KN-23, Kh-22/32, Kalibr and 332 drones; no ballistic or Kh-22/32 missiles reported intercepted
items.nl: Rusland valt Oekraïne in nacht van 16 op 17 oktober aan met Iskander-M/KN-23, Kh-22/32, Kalibr en 332 drones; geen ballistische of Kh-22/32-raketten onderschept gemeld
items.sEn: On the night of 16–17 October Russia carried out a combined missile and drone attack on Ukraine, according to Ukraine's Air Force as reported by Ukrainska Pravda. items.en: Satellite Images Reveal russian Tu-160Ms Being Armed with Kh-101 Missiles at Engels and Tu-95MS, Tu-22M3 Bomber Deployments at Olenya (Defense Express)
items.nl: Satellietbeelden tonen Tu-160M's die op Engels met Kh-101-kruisvluchtwapens worden bewapend en Tu-95MS- en Tu-22M3-bommenwerpers op Olenya

items.en: Sanctions Push Russia's Aviation Industry Into Crisis, Forcing Rostec Restructuring
items.nl: Sancties drijven Russische luchtvaartindustrie in crisis, Rostec dwingt tot herstructurering
items.sEn: Ukrainian defense-news outlet Defense Express reports, citing Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence Service (SZRU), that Western sanctions have pushed Russia's aviation industry into a structural crisis.
